name: Ortur Laser Master H10 40W
tagline: 40W Ortur's enclosed-style H-series — faster frame, tighter integration than LM3
tldr: Ortur Laser Master H10 40W is the 40W SKU on the Ortur ortur laser master h10 line. The H10 is Ortur's step up from the open-frame LM3 line: a more integrated chassis with up to 20W diode power and higher advertised traverse speeds. Verify optical power on the listing — do not assume combined-watt marketing.
mainObjective: Maximum cut speed and depth in the line — engraving remains strong at tuned speeds

priceRange.note: 40W optical module — verify SKU before buying

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: 40W Ortur's enclosed-style H-series — faster frame, tighter integration than LM3
Open-frame layout — laser glasses and ventilation are your responsibility

Best cut headroom in the line — benchmarked around 10 mm basswood-class stock
40W: the most cut-focused head in the Ortur Laser Master H10 line
Reference engrave job on this module: ~12–18 min
cons: Ultra-fine photo engraving may need slower settings than a 10W engraving-first module
Still a diode — clear acrylic production wants CO₂
Open frame: kids, pets, and smoke are not contained
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 40W module on Ortur Laser Master H10. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Treat engraving and cutting as separate profiles. Push cut speeds only after test squares on your material. Compare CO₂ only when clear acrylic or all-day production enters the picture.
